title: "Failed to get number of ready entities for action client: wait set index ... is out of bounds" and "IndexError: wait set index too big" in rclpy: two threads spinning one executor, nodes moved by rclpy.spin_until_future_complete, and the fixes, measured
excerpt: Which rclpy patterns raise the action client wait set index error or IndexError: wait set index too big, how often per run on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical, why Jazzy says Executor is already spinning instead, and three fixes that had zero errors.
